title: Outbound Transfers of Domain Registrations to Another Registrar
content:
## Transfers desk policy — moving Domain Registrations to another registrar

### Conditions for issuing an authorisation code

1. **Status.** An authorisation code may be issued only while the domain status is active or grace. A domain in grace qualifies only where the TLD allows outbound transfer in grace.
2. **Post-registration lock.** An authorisation code may be issued only after the registration date of the domain plus the TLD's post-registration transfer lock days, in calendar days.
3. **Post-transfer-in lock.** For a domain acquired by inbound transfer, an authorisation code may be issued only after the date the inbound transfer completed plus the TLD's post-transfer-in lock days, in calendar days.
4. **Change-of-registrant lock.** After a change of registrant on which the registrant did not opt out, an authorisation code may be issued only after the date of the last change of registrant plus the TLD's change-of-registrant lock days, in calendar days.
5. **Registry lock.** An authorisation code may be issued only while no registry lock is in force on the domain.
6. **Account.** An authorisation code may be issued only while the customer's Harborline account status is active.

**Counting the locks.** Each lock adds whole calendar days to its anchor date, counting the day after the anchor as day 1, and the code may first be issued on the day after the last locked day.

### The code and the transfer

Issuing the code also removes the registrar transfer lock. The code is valid for the TLD's authorisation code validity days, and a new code replaces any earlier one. When a gaining registrar requests the transfer, the registrant may approve or reject it; if neither happens within the TLD's auto-approve days of the request, the transfer is approved automatically, and a TLD whose value is 0 completes on the request itself. A rejected request ends that transfer and the domain stays with Harborline; an approved or auto-approved request completes the transfer and closes the holding without any refund of the remaining registration term.

### Lock boundary cases (abstract)

| Day of the request for a code | Lock of N days from anchor date A |
|---|---|
| A plus N (the last locked day) | code not issued |
| the day after A plus N | code may be issued |

Hypothetical: a domain registered on 1 June 2028 under a 60-day lock has 31 July 2028 as its last locked day; a code may first be issued on 1 August 2028.

### Basis

Every condition is read from the system record: the domain's status, registration date, inbound transfer completion date, last change-of-registrant date and opt-out, registry lock, and the status of the customer's Harborline account.
